name: has_mi
notes: Assume every loan has MI (synthetic tape). Do NOT derive from monthly_insurance_cost (that is hazard/escrow). Materialized on asf_tape.has_mi at load from this CSV.

name: fannie_state_lag_path
source_name: Fannie Mae Foreclosure Time Frames and Compensatory Fee Allowable Delays
notes: state_time_frame_days from LPI due date to FC sale; recovery_lag_months = round(days/30). State is for lag/timing — not recovery rate.

name: psa_base_cpr_seasoning
value: 0.2% CPR × age_months through month 30 then 6% CPR flat
notes: 100% PSA base CPR; engine applies psa_multiple/100. Multiples: Down=75 Base=100 Up=125.

name: sda_base_cdr_seasoning
value: 0.02% CDR × age through mo30; 0.60% peak mo30–60; linear decline to 0.03% by mo120; then 0.03% flat
notes: 100% SDA base CDR; engine applies sda_multiple/100. Multiples: Down=50 Base=100 Up=200.

name: psa_multiples
notes: PCA levels map to PSA multiples.

name: sda_multiples
notes: STA levels map to SDA multiples.

name: severity_ltv_bands
notes: Match original_ltv (fraction) to these bands; >80 cells reflect MI on agency book.

name: severity_fico_bands
notes: Match original_fico to these bands; fico_band=Total is LTV-only fallback inside a vintage.
